text: Sunday Church Jesus, our Savior, Redeemer and King, To You our hearts and our voices we bring. You bore the cross, You conquered the grave, By Your great mercy, our souls You save. Glory to Jesus, the Lamb who was slain, Risen in power, forever to reign! He is our Shepherd, our Truth and our Life, Guiding us home through darkness and strife. Lord of all ages, the Word made flesh, Holy and blameless, pure and afresh. You heal the broken, You calm the sea, You set the prisoner and captive free. Glory to Jesus, the Lamb who was slain, Risen in power, forever to reign! He is our Shepherd, our Truth and our Life, Guiding us home through darkness and strife. We lift our hands in praise to Thee, Your love has set the sinner free. Forever Yours, our hearts proclaim, The matchless power of Jesus’ name! Glory to Jesus, the Lamb who was slain, Risen in power, forever to reign! He is our Shepherd, our Truth and our Life, Now and forever, our glorious Light!
